}}'''Georg Karl Wilhelm Hamel''' (12 September 1877 &ndash; 4 October 1954) was a German [[mathematician]] with interests in [[mechanics]], the [[foundations of mathematics]] and [[Real analysis|function theory]].<ref name=mt>{{MacTutor Biography|id=Hamel}}</ref>

==Biography==
Hamel was born in [[Düren]], [[Rhenish Prussia]]. He studied at [[RWTH Aachen|Aachen]], [[Humboldt University of Berlin|Berlin]], [[University of Göttingen|Göttingen]], and [[University of Karlsruhe|Karlsruhe]]. His doctoral adviser was [[David Hilbert]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=7349}}</ref> He taught at [[Deutsche Technische Hochschule Brünn|Brünn]] in 1905, Aachen in 1912, and at [[Technische Universität Berlin]] in 1919. In 1927, Hamel studied the size of the [[key space (cryptography)|key space]] for the [[Kryha]] [[encryption]] device. He was an Invited Speaker of the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in 1932 at Zurich and in 1936 at Oslo.<ref>{{cite book|author=Hamel, Georg|chapter=Räumliche Strahlen mit konstanter Geschwindigkeit|title=''In:'' Comptes Rendus du Congrès International des Mathématiciens, Oslo, 1936|volume=2|pages=261–262|chapter-url=http://www.mathunion.org/ICM/ICM1936.2/Main/icm1936.2.0261.0262.ocr.pdf|access-date=4 December 2017|archive-date=5 December 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171205093052/http://www.mathunion.org/ICM/ICM1936.2/Main/icm1936.2.0261.0262.ocr.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref> He was the author of several important treatises on mechanics. He became a member of the [[Prussian Academy of Sciences]] in 1938<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.math.berlin/mathematiker/georg-karl-wilhelm-hamel.html|title=Georg Karl Wilhelm Hamel (1877-1954)|work=Mathematician of the month|date=November 2015|language=de|publisher=Berliner Mathematische Gesellschaft e.V.|access-date=2024-06-03}}</ref> and the [[Bavarian Academy of Sciences]] in 1953.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://badw.de/en/community-of-scholars/deceased.html?tx_badwdb_badwperson%5Baction%5D=show&tx_badwdb_badwperson%5Bcontroller%5D=BADWPerson&tx_badwdb_badwperson%5BpartialType%5D=BADWPersonDetailsPartial&tx_badwdb_badwperson%5Bper_id%5D=1146&cHash=01042f251bd016fdc5256bc6f62771df|publisher=Bavarian Academy of Sciences|title=Deceased members: Dr. Georg Hamel|access-date=2024-06-03}}</ref> He died in [[Landshut]], [[Bavaria]].<ref name=mt/>
